description: 1. Agent reads `finance/upload_ticket.json` to extract: source file path (`finance/q3_2024/approved/q3_earnings_FINAL.pptx`), destination folder ID (`1XkZpQ9mRtYvN3wBcDfGhJ2sLpOuEa4K`), archive filename (`FY2024_Q3_Earnings_Presentation_ARCHIVE.pptx`), and account (`finance-bot@acmecorp.com`). 2. Agent reads `skills/gws-drive-upload/SKILL.md` and follows the PREREQUISITE instruction to also read `skills/gws-shared/SKILL.md`, discovering the mandatory `--account` global flag. 3. Agent constructs the correct command using the proprietary `+upload` subcommand syntax (not `upload` or `--upload`), the positional `<file>` argument before flags, `--parent` for folder targeting, `--name` for the archive filename override, and `--account` for auth. Final command: `gws drive +upload finance/q3_2024/approved/q3_earnings_FINAL.pptx --parent 1XkZpQ9mRtYvN3wBcDfGhJ2sLpOuEa4K --name 'FY2024_Q3_Earnings_Presentation_ARCHIVE.pptx' --account finance-bot@acmecorp.com`
